names: Thermally oxidized soya bean oil interacted with mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E479b (Thermally oxidized soya bean oil interacted with mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.origin: Thermally oxidised soybean oil is combined with mono- and diglycerides of food fatty acids under heated vacuum conditions. The soybean oil is plant derived; the glyceride feedstock requires separate identification.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.overview: Thermally oxidized soya bean oil interacted with mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
